mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from t-1mo to t) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising above their 12-month average and industrial production (INDPRO) is rising above their 12-month average, it signals a synchronized expansion in both demand and supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces corporate borrowing capacity and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1300.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor force participation (PAYEMS) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it signals an overheating economy with tight labor markets and restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month average and FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.0%), strong employment growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.
